name: compact-light
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied Wave Player mockup as one individual polished UI image. Refine typography and top information spacing throughout; preserve the established card composition, content, visualization art, waveform treatment and navigation arrangement.

TYPOGRAPHY: deliberate three-font hierarchy. Main loaded title "Low Tide" uses Inter Medium, approximately 22 CSS px, normal tracking, not a large monospaced headline. Artist/album line uses TX-02 Regular approximately 12 CSS px: "North Window · Tidal Studies". Use TX-02 for all time values, filenames, counts and supporting library metadata. Library track titles and text actions use compact Inter Medium/Regular about 13–14px. Departure Mono is reserved for small short state labels PLAYING / SELECTED and loop boundary markers; make its distinctive pixel forms visible, not generic Courier. Never use a serif. Maintain readable contrast and optical hierarchy. No huge uppercase labels or widely spaced text.

HEADER: tightly compose title and metadata as a single unit with approximately 3 CSS px gap and 10px left/right inset, 8px top/bottom. Align the left edge of title, metadata and waveform information. Replace the pipe separator with a middle dot. Reduce the current oversized header and rebalance the freed space into the main content field, not blank padding. Where Library has its own heading, place its label and subdued "5 files" count on one compact row with aligned utilities instead of stacking count into a tall band.

GEOMETRY: ALL button backgrounds have ZERO radius. Pause must have a modest solid SQUARE neutral background with four sharp 90-degree corners, about 36–40 CSS px square. Any selected Repeat background is a smaller sharp SQUARE, never circular. Preserve normal Phosphor icon glyph curves; this rule is about button surfaces. Use consistent regular Phosphor icons for Queue, Repeat, SkipBack, Pause, SkipForward, SpeakerHigh and back/add/close. The main playback group remains independently CENTERED. Small utility group left; speaker alone right. No theme control, no volume slider, no text A/B button, no Visual/Library tabs. Do not add controls.

Preserve thin structural rules, zero-radius card and library rows, neutral selected-row fill and restrained dotted focus outline. Tighten spacing, not readability. Keep the distinction between loaded/playing Low Tide and browsing-selected Glass Current. Keep all five fixture rows with their exact content where a library exists. Caption outside the UI exactly "Design fixture — simulated waveform and playback". Preserve the reference image aspect ratio. No extra annotations or comparison panels.

COMPACT LIGHT view: preserve the dominant green oscilloscope on black, full-track amplitude overview below it, 01:24 / 04:32 readout, loop OFF with no editor. Warm near-white ground, white card, charcoal ink. Retain the portrait object and surrounding board.
